profiles_note: Approximate silhouettes, not survey cross-sections. Each is hand-built from published heights of camps and landmarks along the standard route on the south side (Khumbu and South Col for Everest; Godwin-Austen Glacier and Abruzzi Spur for K2), continued down the north face to the glacier below. Horizontal spacing is estimated from maps and may be off by a kilometre or more.
